01-new-year-livestream.jpg.en: Chinese New Year livestream for the JD Xi self-operated store, clearing festival stock on the eve of the eve.
01-new-year-livestream.jpg.zh: 京喜自营年货节直播，小年夜的年货清仓场。

02-youth-livestream.jpg.en: “JD Youth Merchandising” — the buyers hosting their own categories on camera.
02-youth-livestream.jpg.zh: 「京东青春采销」—— 采销自己上镜，卖自己负责的品类。

03-flower-livestream.jpg.en: Valentine’s Day flower session: ranunculus at 15.88 yuan, and a great many vases to fill live.
03-flower-livestream.jpg.zh: 情人节鲜花专场：15.88 元的洋牡丹，以及镜头前那一排要现场插满的花瓶。

04-mentor.jpg.en: With my mentor at JD, on the Pearl River in Guangzhou. She is from Yunnan, unfailingly patient and kind, and taught me most of what I know about running a category. We still keep in touch.
04-mentor.jpg.zh: 与我在京东的 mentor，摄于广州珠江边。云南姐姐，善良又耐心，品类运营的大半功夫都是她教我的。我们至今仍保持联系。
